admission.justification: Prevents a retained facade from silently trying a retired native launch whose tool server no longer exists.

applicability: The retained Presenter facade when constructed without a runner and given an otherwise admitted explicit start.
conditions: The constructor selects UnconfiguredPresenterRunner when no runner is supplied.
The selected runner refuses its start with no-confined-harness; the failed attempt records that named refusal.
exclusions: An explicitly injected runner retains its own behavior.
This does not claim that the failed attempt writes no attempt metadata or working-folder bytes.
statement: A presenter constructed without an explicitly wired runner refuses authoring as no-confined-harness and prepares no native host launch.
